about: Hand-labelled evaluation set for the gluten analysis. Labels describe the real product risk read from the full list, never the output of a model. truth: GLUTEN (contains gluten or a typical gluten ingredient), TRACES (declared precaution, no gluten ingredient), GF_DECLARED (reliable product-level 'sin gluten' and no gluten ingredient), SAFE (no gluten ingredient, no declaration). Cases with origin 'ai-gluten-cases' come from apps/server/tests/fixtures/ai-gluten-cases.json (g=1 -> GLUTEN, g=0 -> SAFE). The rest were written for this set on 2026-11-13 and still need a second human review.
